The '''''Alliance I'' [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]''' was a military officer in the service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Galactic Republic Navy]], during the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]] of [[3998 BBY]].

==Biography==
During the [[Second Battle of Onderon]], he held command alongside [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nomi Sunrider]] of the [[Republic command ship]] ''[[Alliance I]]''. He personally followed Nomi Sunrider to the surface of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
